    The 2026 Masters Tournament weekend coverage (April 11-12) features early play on Paramount+ from noon–2 p.m. ET, followed by the main broadcast on CBS from 2–7 p.m. ET. Featured group coverage runs from roughly 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. daily on digital platforms including Masters.com, the Masters App, and Paramount+. 
    Saturday, April 11 (Round 3) 
    • Featured Groups: 10:15 a.m.–7 p.m. ET (Masters.com, Paramount+, Prime Video)
    • "On the Range": 10 a.m.–noon ET (CBS Sports Network, Paramount+)
    • Early Coverage: 12–2 p.m. ET (Paramount+)
    • TV Coverage (Round 3):
      2–7 p.m. ET (CBS)
       
    Sunday, April 12 (Round 4) 
    • Featured Groups: 10:15 a.m.–7 p.m. ET (Masters.com, Paramount+, Prime Video)
    • Early Coverage: 12–2 p.m. ET (Paramount+)
    • TV Coverage (Round 4): 2–7 p.m. ET (CBS) 
    Note: You can stream the CBS broadcast via Fubo or use the Paramount+ Premium plan for live coverage.

    AI Overview
    For the weekend of the 2026 Masters (April 11–12), coverage shifts to CBS for the main telecast from 2–7 p.m. ET, with early streaming coverage on Paramount+ from noon–2 p.m. ET. Specialized feeds like Amen Corner are available on Masters.com, the Masters App, and Prime Video. 
    • Saturday (Round 3): 12–2 p.m. (Paramount+), 2–7 p.m. (CBS).
    • Sunday (Round 4): 12–2 p.m. (Paramount+), 2–7 p.m. (CBS).
    • Streaming/Cable: The fubo TV app and DIRECTV carry the CBS broadcast.
    • Featured Holes: Amen Corner (11, 12, 13) and Holes 15 & 16 start at 11:45 a.m. ET on Masters.com and app. 
    Note: ESPN handled coverage for rounds 1 and 2 (Thursday/Friday)
